description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableSet class, a persistent, journaling-based set implementation in Orleans. It verifies core set operations such as add, remove, persistence, handling of complex types, enumeration, set-theoretic operations, and performance with large datasets.

classes.name: DurableSetTests
classes.description: A test suite for the DurableSet class, verifying its functionality and correctness across various scenarios.

methods.name: DurableSet_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests standard add, remove, and duplicate prevention operations of DurableSet.

methods.name: DurableSet_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the DurableSet persists its state correctly across recreation.

methods.name: DurableSet_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Checks handling and deduplication of complex value types with proper equality implementations.

methods.name: DurableSet_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the Clear operation of DurableSet to ensure all items are removed and state is journaled.

methods.name: DurableSet_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Verifies enumeration support and conversion to other collection types.

methods.name: DurableSet_LargeNumberOfItems_Test
methods.description: Stress test with large volume of items to evaluate performance and recovery.

methods.name: DurableSet_SetOperations_Test
methods.description: Demonstrates and tests set-theoretic operations like intersection, union, and difference.

methods.name: DurableSet_ExceptWith_Test
methods.description: Tests removal of multiple specific items and verifies the final set contents.
